PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.1, hemoglobin 13.2, platelets 246, sodium 139, wbc 5.5; vitals dbp 74-79, heart_rate 71-75, map 93-97, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 130-137, spo2 96-97, temp 36.6-36.8

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 73-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Syncope. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
